program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        counts = Counter(row)

    return out

source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) > 1:
            split = next(i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value != row[0])
            out[r] = row[:split] + [1] * (len(row) - split)
    return out
'''
